_comment: Owner-editable casting sheet for Zone 1 (k26_30). Fill in voice_id per speaker x locale before running --audition. Leave a voice_id blank/null to skip that line in the audition sample. Values here are never generated automatically and never overwrite canonical dialogue.

audition_sample_lines._comment: One representative canonical line per role x locale, pulled verbatim from zone1_beat_manifest.json. Used only by --audition. Do not edit text here independently of the manifest.

anna.en: The morning bells haven't rung yet, but the village wind already carries a hint of... something unusual.
anna.zh-TW: 清晨的鐘聲還沒響起，村子的風，已經帶來一絲……不尋常的氣息。

elder.en: If you want to leave the village, play one game with me first.
elder.zh-TW: 想出村，就先陪我下一局。
